label: Formulated and introduced Falsificationism & Demarcation
description: Karl Popper formulated and introduced the concept of "Falsificationism & Demarcation", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Karl Popper's canonical writings.

label: Popper debated Kuhn vigorously over scientific rationality, rejecting normal science as dogmatic and defending critical falsificationism
description: Thomas Kuhn engaged in a direct critique of Karl Popper's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Karl Popper's perspective to Thomas Kuhn's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.
